what: L10 seed variance: TRAINING-seed spread, the noise band adaptation deltas are judged against.
deviations_from_guide_row_4_3: 3 seeds (42/43/44), not the 4 the row specifies.
Run on Colab A100, not the 4x24 rig; the rig was never used for this.
Config is the adapted 16 fps run evaluated on the dev split at cap 100 -- i.e. the spread is measured at the operating point the adaptation claim is made at, not at a separate control config.
This is TRAINING-seed spread. results/block4/adapt_ci_mac_repro_4seeds.json is a different quantity: bootstrap RESAMPLING seeds 0-3 over one fixed model.
reading: Seed noise is 0.05 BLEU-4 / 0.15 ROUGE-L (max-min). The adaptation gain of +1.04 ROUGE-L is ~7x this spread, so it is not a seed artefact. Any claimed delta below ~0.2 ROUGE-L or ~0.05 BLEU-4 is indistinguishable from retraining the same config.
